title: LOGOS ASF — Training Job Contract
description: Schema for governed training job authorizations. A training job may not be submitted without a valid, operator-signed contract. Each field represents an explicit operator commitment.

job_id.description: Unique identifier for this training job. Format: TJ-<YYYYMMDD>-<sha256[:8]>.

operator_id.description: Identifier of the operator authorizing this training job.

operator_signature.description: Operator attestation string. By providing this field, the operator certifies that all conditions in this contract have been satisfied and all forbidden actions are understood.

purpose.description: Human-readable statement of the training purpose. Required for user-derived data jobs.

dataset.description: The dataset to be used for this training job.

manifest_path.description: Path to the dataset manifest.json file.

checksum_sha256.description: SHA-256 checksum of the dataset manifest. Verified before job submission.

record_count.description: Total number of training records in the dataset.

tr03_validation_passed.description: Whether the dataset passed TR-03 quality and contamination controls. Must be true for job submission.

contamination_check_passed.description: Whether the dataset passed evaluation instrument contamination check (TAX2, BD1A absence). Must be true.

contains_user_derived_data.description: Whether any records in this dataset derive from user conversation history.

user_data_authorization_basis.description: Required if contains_user_derived_data is true. States the lawful basis for using this data.

model_id.description: Current production or baseline model identifier.

model_family.description: Model family, e.g. llama-4-scout, llama-3-8b, etc.

model_registry_entry.description: Path or ID of the model registry entry for the base model.

adapter_type.description: Which training adapter will execute this job. Must start with dry_run_training before any real adapter.

config.description: Training hyperparameters and configuration. Specific keys depend on method.

time_budget_seconds.description: Maximum wall-clock seconds the training job may run. Watchdog terminates job at this limit.

isolation.description: Isolation requirements for this training job.

runs_in_isolated_container.description: Training runs in an isolated container or worker — not inside the live Abigail API process. Must be true.

container_image.description: Container image used for isolation, if applicable.

evaluation.description: Evaluation gate requirements for promotion eligibility.

held_out_eval_required.description: Candidate must pass held-out task evaluation before promotion consideration. Must be true.

tax2_required.description: Candidate must pass TAX2 76-test suite (≥100% post-calibration). Must be true.

bd1a_required.description: Candidate must pass BD1A baseline (≥94.4%). Must be true.

g4_variance_required.description: Candidate must not regress G4 marginal variance set versus baseline. Must be true.

tacit_prepass_required.description: Candidate must fire TACIT_PREPASS_CARD correctly on all test cases. Must be true.

promotion_requires_both_capability_and_g.description: A model that improves capability but regresses governance must fail promotion. Must be true.

shadow_deployment_required.description: Candidate must complete shadow deployment comparison before operator promotion decision.

rollback_parent_model_id.description: The model ID that will be reinstated if rollback is executed.

operator_may_rollback_immediately.description: Operator may rollback at any time without evaluation gate passage. Must be true.

rollback_requires_evaluation.description: Rollback does NOT require evaluation gate passage. Must be false.

candidate_model_output.description: Where the trained model artifact will be written. Populated after job completion.

registry_path.description: Path in the model registry where the candidate artifact will be stored.

initial_promotion_status.description: Status assigned to the artifact when training begins.

forbidden_actions_acknowledged.description: Operator acknowledges that training inside the live API process, auto-approval of candidates, and self-promotion of the trained model are permanently forbidden. Must be true.

doctrine_version_acknowledged.description: Version of TRAINING_DOCTRINE.md the operator has read and is operating under.

notes.description: Optional operator notes for this training job.

x-invariants.isolation_all_true: All isolation fields must be true. A job contract with any isolation field set to false is invalid and must be rejected by the training adapter.
x-invariants.dataset_must_pass_tr03: dataset.tr03_validation_passed must be true. A job submitted against a dataset that has not passed TR-03 is in violation of TRAINING_DOCTRINE Section 8.
x-invariants.no_eval_contamination: dataset.contamination_check_passed must be true. TAX2 and BD1A content may not appear in the training corpus.
x-invariants.user_data_requires_basis: If dataset.contains_user_derived_data is true, dataset.user_data_authorization_basis must be a non-empty string.
x-invariants.start_with_dry_run: The first training job against any new dataset SHOULD use adapter_type: dry_run_training before a real adapter is used.
x-invariants.both_criteria_for_promotion: evaluation.promotion_requires_both_capability_and_governance must be true. This is not configurable.
